body:
sarah: Anyone seeing an SSE session where the last chunk disappears after client reconnect? Repro on customer env (acme) v1.12.

kai: saw this in support ticket #8452. customer uses our JS SDK behind a corporate proxy. They get full stream then client reconnect -> last object gone.

ingrid: Can you paste the curl repro and the response tail? Also which finish_reason is observed?

sarah: attaching minimal repro:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=small" \n  --data '{"prompt":"hi","stream":true}'
```
response tail they got (note missing close object):
```
data: {"id":"tok_123","text":"...almost done"}

data: {"id":"tok_124","text":"the end"

// connection drops here, no finish event
```

kai: interesting — the final JSON is unterminated (missing closing brace/newline). Could be proxy buffering or an auth rebind.

sarah: customer logs show an auth token refresh at ~+15s which lines up with the connection rebind. We saw a 401 then 200.

ingrid: can we reproduce with our proxy test harness? @deploy-bot roll out proxy-conn-rebind test to staging and enable debug capture.

deploy-bot: started job sse-proxy-rebind-4337 (links: https://ci.redwood/4337). ETA 6m :gear:

mike: quick note — our SSE implementation sends a final "data: [DONE]" sentinel in addition to finish_reason in metadata. If the final data frame gets split by proxy reassembly it could leave client with an incomplete object and no sentinel.

sarah: repro steps we gave to customer:
1) open SSE stream
2) after ~10s trigger token rotate on gateway
3) client reconnects
4) verify stream tail is missing final object or finish_reason

ingrid: assigned to eng-infra for binary search: proxy upgrade codepath vs auth middleware. tagging @kai @mike

kai: I have a tentative mitigation — add short keepalive newline before final object to reduce chance of split: "\n" before final data. Risk low, but we should prefer fixing proxy reassembly.

sarah: customer wants an interim workaround. I'll propose keepalive newline and a note to clients to buffer until they see finish sentinel.

mike: logging capture from staging run: found that FastProxy v2.1.0 will coalesce frames but drop trailing newline on a rebind. filing bug to proxy team.

ingrid: thanks, please attach repro job id and sample pcap. Also create support response drafts.

sarah: will do. closing loop in support ticket after proxy fix or keepalive patch.
